description: The plot illustrates the relationship between different ratios of direct assessment to pairwise ranking and corresponding performance metrics. The x-axis is labeled “Direct Assessment : Pairwise Ranking Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 1:9 to 9:1, with tick labels at intervals of 0.7. The y-axis is labeled “Direct Assessment Correlation / Pairwise Ranking Accuracy” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 0.675, with tick labels at intervals of 0.025. A green line, marked with circles, represents “Direct Assessment Correlation” and begins at approximately 0.585 at 1:9, decreases to approximately 0.525 at 2:8, increases to approximately 0.63 at 4:6, then declines to approximately 0.55 at 9:1. A blue line, marked with squares, represents “Pairwise Ranking Accuracy” and starts at approximately 0.665 at 1:9, decreases to approximately 0.55 at 2:8, increases to approximately 0.61 at 4:6, then declines to approximately 0.51 at 9:1. A black line, marked with squares, represents “Average Performance” and begins at approximately 0.59 at 1:9, increases to approximately 0.61 at 2:8, reaches a peak of approximately 0.625 at 3:7, declines to approximately 0.60 at 4:6, increases to approximately 0.61 at 5:5, then declines to approximately 0.57 at 9:1.
